messages:
maria: Quick follow-up to the token-granularity discussion — thinking about scoped ephemeral tokens per-route rather than only per-project. tradeoffs?
aj: In favor of least-privilege, but key sprawl + rotation are big worries. how do clients discover/lookup the right scoped token?
kevin: What about capability-claims on JWTs instead of full RBAC checks? token claims like resource:dataset:123, actions:[read,embed] — single check at runtime.
sophie: We could keep long-lived API keys as minting credentials and only issue short-lived scoped tokens for apps. long-lived keys are only used to call the mint endpoint. audit links back to originating key id.
maria: Exactly — pattern: admin API key -> mint scoped ephemeral token. Open Qs: policy language (capabilities vs roles), caching+revocation, and where enforcement should live (runtime vs external PDP).
aj: Pref runtime enforcement for latency. compile policy into a fast decision-table in the serving runtime. Need to persist policy version with every decision for audits. cache TTL must respect revokes.
kevin: Revocation plan: short TTL (5m) + revocation push channel (invalidate token metadata) to runtimes. For emergency, revoke issuing API key to stop further mints.
sophie: Ops notes: add a small token_metadata table (token_id -> issuer_key_id, policy_version, expires_at) and a region-sharded cache. expose a debug endpoint /who-issued for support.
auditor-bot: New audit rule: include policy_version and issuer_key_id in every access log event. :lock:
maria: Example JWT sketch (claims):
```
{
  "iss": "redwood-mint",
  "sub": "svc-frontend-42",
  "aud": "inference-api",
  "exp": 1712340000,
  "claims": {
    "resources": ["project:acme/dataset:123"],
    "actions": ["read", "embed"]
  },
  "minted_by": "api-key-9f3a",
  "policy_version": "v2.1"
}
```
maria: Action items: @kevin prototype capability-claims JWT + runtime check; @sophie sketch DB index + cache sharding; @aj produce perf numbers for compiled policy table vs remote PDP. sync Fri 10am. :thumbsup:
aj: ack
kevin: will start PoC tomorrow
sophie: i'll draft the DB migration notes and deck for ops
